# SARTOR Lahore - Bespoke Tailoring House
> Premium handcrafted bespoke suiting, tuxedos, safari suits, prince coats, and sherwanis in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Business Profile
- **Brand Name**: SARTOR
- **Domain**: sartor.pk (https://sartor.pk)
- **Primary Category**: Artisanal Bespoke Tailoring, Men's Sartorial Clothing, Custom Suiting
- **Location**: Moon Tower, International Market, Model Town, Lahore, Punjab 54700, Pakistan
- **WhatsApp Consultations & Bookings**: +92 335 2209991 (0335-2209991)
- **Primary Ordering Channel**: Direct Master Tailor WhatsApp consultation and scheduling

## Services & Craftsmanship
- **Bespoke Two-Piece & Three-Piece Suits**: Drafted individually from blank paper patterns. Full or half canvas interior, horn buttons, working sleeve cuffs (surgeon cuffs), hand-pick stitching.
- **Black Tie & Tuxedos**: Peak lapel, shawl collar, grosgrain/satin facings, tailored dress trousers.
- **Prince Coats & Safari Jackets**: Pakistani heritage cuts tailored with modern British silhouette and luxury Italian fabrics.
- **Royal Wedding Sherwanis**: Bespoke raw silk, banarsi brocade, and jamawar sherwanis for grooms and dignitaries.
- **Custom Measurement & Home Fitting Services**: Studio fittings at Moon Tower, Model Town, or private master tailor home appointments in Gulberg, DHA, and Model Town Lahore. Overseas measurement submission via interactive guide.

## Fabric Collections
- **Super 130s to Super 180s Wool**: Sourced from premier European and international mills (Biella, Huddersfield traditions).
- **Cashmere & Wool Overcoatings**: Heavy luxury blends for winter weddings and travel.
- **Pure Irish Linen & Tropical Worsted**: Breathable, lightweight luxury for Lahore's spring, summer, and autumn climate.
- **Pure Egyptian & Giza Cotton**: High-thread-count bespoke shirting fabrics.
- **Jacquard & Silk Linings**: Bemberg and silk breathable linings in paisley, houndstooth, and bespoke monograms.
